Capgemini Engineering is hiring an Embedded Software Engineer to develop and validate embedded software across low-level, application, safety-critical, and model-driven areas. The role includes work on drivers, firmware, infotainment systems, and embedded products requiring verification, validation, or regulatory compliance.
